P5-rebind.dc.html.title: 5 Hold a hot key to change it

t1.text: Phone layout in the game: final mockups

s1.text:
What is on the screen

Fight card on top, only while fighting: names and two bars.

Map lens top right (cast iron ring, window reflection). Tap to step three zoom levels. Three keys on it: panes (top left), fullscreen (top right), Comm with unread count (bottom right). The lens hides when something would collide with it; its three keys then stay as a row.

Bottom right: the compass from the bottom edge (the eye is look, F is flee). Above it, along the right edge, up to three hot keys with K1 lowest. The K key left of N shows and hides them.

Bottom left: menu key and the command field.

s2.text:
Hot keys: tap sends, hold opens the box. A label of at most four letters, a command, or a special. The two specials set wimpy to 50 % or 25 % of your current HP (read from the game data at the press).

Keyboard up: compass and hot keys are hidden, the command field takes the full width, the lens stays.

Menu: Reconnect, Profile, Scripts, Settings, text size, Black / Paper, Exit session.
